name: Individual Paired Differences Are Nonzero Divisors
statement: For the signed minimally-missing-pattern ideal $Q_C\subseteq k[x_{i,0},x_{i,1}]$, each individual difference $x_{i,1}-x_{i,0}$ is a nonzero divisor on the original ring $S/Q_C$, before any variable pairs are identified.
hypotheses: Finite nonempty binary class over any coefficient field.
